svg.text: Rear view: two Mean Well LRS-100-5 (as seen standing behind the wall)
HUB75 ribbon (20 cm, in a row)
HUB75 ribbon (30 cm, row to row)
Each panel's own lead: plug into its 5 V socket, then screw the red fork to the + bar and the black fork to the GND bar,
both at the slot with that panel's number. Shaded red: panels on supply A. Shaded blue: supply B.
